dedupe.result: All three additions are new to the completed ledger. They cover distinct evidence classes: a synthetic Bayesian drift-diagnosis workflow for laser-plasma accelerators, an experimental magnetosonic density diagnostic on the Big Red Ball, and an adaptive-mesh Vlasov solver benchmark for plasma-wall modeling.

evidence_boundary: The drift-diagnosis results use synthetic sessions generated within the same model family used for inference; the method was not demonstrated on attributed experimental LPA operations. The magnetosonic profile is a real Big Red Ball experiment with a Langmuir-probe cross-check, but it covers an initial one-dimensional low-beta state rather than reconnection-time structure. The kobra results are author-run low-dimensional benchmarks, not local source execution or a production plasma-wall validation.
